presentation_revision_history.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE square premium painterly naturalistic mythology illustration of DEATH, selecting the documented modern Grim Reaper personification ONLY. A single human SKELETON wearing a plain dark hooded ROBE stands on a quiet misty old stone path and holds one SCYTHE with a curved agricultural blade and long wooden handle. Skull clearly visible beneath hood, empty eye sockets without glowing lights, bony hands grip shaft naturally. Two arms and two legs beneath robe; full figure and scythe blade inside frame. Skeletal ribs partly visible within open robe, tasteful depiction without gore or corpses. Death is calm and solemn, neither vicious nor comic. Strong natural moonlight and deep shadows reveal bone texture and worn linen; ordinary nonluminous mist lies far behind along stone path. Convey uncanny inevitable presence through still posture, centered imposing framing and cold natural light. No wings, horse, crown, hourglass, magical aura, neon outline, eye glow, luminous coloured fog, energy ribbon, souls as floating lights, lettering, border, collage, watermark or modern setting. Treat this as a contemporary artistic rendering of the documented Grim Reaper variant, not a universal traditional appearance of death.
